visualCharacteristics.purpose: Disclosure holding a long link list that flows into 4 columns; open on desktop, collapsed on mobile
visualCharacteristics.description: H2 then 73 blue text links flowing into 4 columns on desktop; on mobile the list sits in a collapsed details. Source duplicates the list (details.desk-only and details.mobile-only): use only one copy.

contentPattern.structure: one row. Cell 1: title ("Todos os nossos serviços"). Cell 2: unordered list of links. Extra rows add more disclosures with the same behaviour
contentPattern.blockContent: Disclosure titled 'Todos os nossos serviços' with a list of 73 service links in 4 columns
contentPattern.source: One row: cell 1 'Todos os nossos serviços'; cell 2 unordered list of 73 links (use only details.desk-only, ignore the duplicate details.mobile-only). Open by default on desktop, list flows into 4 columns.

usage: Site-map style "all services" lists at the bottom of a page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any long link index. Use accordion-faq for question/answer content.
